user.title: Add a timer bridge
user.description: Enter the address shown in the HA Timer Bridge app on your tablet.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the pairing code shown in the HA Timer Bridge app on the tablet.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the tablet. Check it is awake and on the same network.
error.invalid_code: That pairing code does not match the one on the tablet.
error.not_a_bridge: That address answered, but it is not running HA Timer Bridge.
error.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no internal URL the tablet could post to. Set one under Settings, System, Network.

abort.already_configured: This tablet is already set up.
abort.no_device_id: The tablet did not identify itself properly.
